title: How to connect the Air Purifier [X Series]
body_html:
How to connect the Air Purifier for X Series Laser Machine

Learn how to properly connect and set up the Air Purifier for your X Series machine, including installation, power connection, and airflow adjustment for optimal performance.

1. Preparation

Consumable preparation:

  • One Laser X model device x 1
  • Air Purifier x 1
  • Phillips screwdriver x 1

Debug software: None

2. Operation step

Step 1. Install the equipment air duct to the air inlet of the purifier

Use a cross screwdriver to tighten the hose clamp.

Step 2. Connect the purifier to the power supply

Step 3. Turn on the power of the purifier, start the purifier, and adjust the air volume to the highest.
